blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Vice President Sara Duterte on Saturday denied that she owns a Jollibee franchise amid her links to food company GenCorp Industries Inc., stressing that her investment in the company does not equate to ownership. “I do not own a Jollibee franchise or any other franchise. I previously invested in a company that is part of a legitimate business organization owned and operated by individuals with an established reputation for integrity and good standing,” she said in a statement. Duterte made the statement following a media report about the Jollibee branches allegedly owned by GenCorp, which was earlier disclosed by a […]...
